9b3d1a67-941f-4538-9e75-3797eeb3771f.description: Female knight Leo has never had ladylike qualities, she's a soldier through and through, adorned with scars and rock hard abs to match. She's never really been treated as a woman…until one day the magician Fooly confesses his love for everything about her. These two will challenge the quest named "Romance", which is tougher to complete than a super hard dungeon! How will our steel-willed protagonist act in the face of love?

0cf1c1c7-2894-4b4d-a3cc-3e1501fb3e36.title: Ore no Class ni Wakagaetta Moto Yome ga Iru
0cf1c1c7-2894-4b4d-a3cc-3e1501fb3e36.altTitle: I Have a Rejuvenated Ex-Wife in My Class
0cf1c1c7-2894-4b4d-a3cc-3e1501fb3e36.description:
Kohei memutuskan mengakhiri pernikahannya dengan sang istri, Yuzuka. Namun, sepulang dari mengurus surat cerai, Yuzuka hampir tertabrak mobil. Kohei refleks melindunginya dan kehilangan nyawanya.

Saat sadar, ia terbangun di ranjang rumah orang tuanya, di depan adiknya yang kembali muda. Ia ternyata bereinkarnasi ke masa SMA. Di kehidupan keduanya ini, Kohei kembali bersekolah… dan di kelasnya ada Yuzuka, mantan istrinya. Akankah hubungan mereka kali ini berakhir berbeda, atau justru kembali menjadi suami istri?

ef105a86-4b7e-4ac4-b45c-b7d83b8f5b5e.title: Teto X Egen
ef105a86-4b7e-4ac4-b45c-b7d83b8f5b5e.description:
Haeseon, a driven "Teto girl" whose entire life revolves around her career, and Sunho, a quiet "Egen guy" who wants nothing more than to stay home with his cat.

Living in entirely different worlds, the two were like parallel lines destined never to cross. That is, until they are forced onto the same Task Force team—and to make matters worse, they discover they live right next door to each other! As their daily routines become hopelessly entangled, Sunho's "first love" suddenly enters the picture...!

What will become of this chaotic, nerve-wracking, and strangely heart-fluttering romance between two complete opposites?

(Source: Millie ui Seojae, edited)

39c9c088-3a83-4e61-a129-35fe299bbe3c.title: Monogatari no Kuromaku ni Tensei Shite
39c9c088-3a83-4e61-a129-35fe299bbe3c.altTitle: Reincarnated as the Mastermind Behind the Story
39c9c088-3a83-4e61-a129-35fe299bbe3c.description: Ada game yang populer secara global yang disebut "The Legend of the Seven Heroes". Ren menyelesaikan sekuel game itu dengan rekor tercepat di dunia, dan dengan demikian ia memperoleh bonus data khusus. Namun, ke mana pun dia melihat ke dalam game, dia tidak dapat menemukan datanya. Saat Ren hendak menyerah mencari, dia memutuskan untuk mulai memainkan putaran kedua permainan. Tiba-tiba, pesan notifikasi “Do you want to start a special story?” muncul di layar. Saat Ren memilih "Ya" tanpa ragu, dia kehilangan kesadaran, dan saat dia bangun, dia masih bayi. —- Mungkinkah ia bereinkarnasi sebagai salah satu pahlawan dalam "The Legend of the Seven Heroes"? Ren, yang menganggap hal seperti itu tidak mungkin, tidak dapat mempercayai telinganya ketika mendengar namanya dari mulut ibunya. Itu adalah nama teman sekelas yang mengkhianati para pahlawan di tengah cerita. Tentu saja, dia ingin hidup damai. Namun di dalam game, dia bertemu dengan seorang suci yang hidupnya harus dia ambil, dan ternyata tidak. Terlebih lagi, dia akhirnya menyelamatkan karakter (bos dari keluarga bangsawan besar) yang seharusnya mati. Semua hal ini menciptakan perkembangan yang dia tidak tahu tentang datang untuk bermain…

a0f5d36b-3af9-412a-ae65-8973bad10245.title: Top 1 Fighting Tutoring
a0f5d36b-3af9-412a-ae65-8973bad10245.description:
The bullied loser Kim Jaehyuk receives 'Top 1 Fighting Tutoring'!
Kim Jaehyuk is a high school student who has been living in despair under the torment of bullies. He's good at studying, but he'd rather be good at fighting.
Then, as if by fate, a 'fighting tutor' comes into his life!

d57884f5-17f6-4295-ad66-c5dfa817180e.title: You Are Slugger
d57884f5-17f6-4295-ad66-c5dfa817180e.description: Uonuma Wako is a high school girl aiming to become a professional baseball player. A genius slugger with a powerful swing as her weapon… but in everyday life, she's a surprisingly clumsy and inept girl. Even though her days are full of trouble, supported by her childhood friend Taiji and those around her, Wako continues to move forward with all her might.

b6b87e4d-c1cc-4d0b-8588-df715dd98624.title: Leadale no Daichi nite
b6b87e4d-c1cc-4d0b-8588-df715dd98624.description:
The last thing she can remember is her life support beginning to fail. Her body had suffered terribly after a fateful accident and the only freedom left in her life came from the VR world of Leadale. Now she finds herself in a country very similar to Leadale and 200 years have passed.
___

de02b7e1-a8a9-4da8-8790-3e79ef70ab1c.title: Buta Kizoku wa Mirai wo Kiri Hiraku you desu
de02b7e1-a8a9-4da8-8790-3e79ef70ab1c.altTitle: The Pig Noble Carves Out a Different Future
de02b7e1-a8a9-4da8-8790-3e79ef70ab1c.description:
The glory of the past is long gone. 

Once hailed as a prodigy, now mocked as the "Pig Noble" due to his arrogance and appearance, Herbert, the son of a ducal family, falls into despair upon receiving a letter through temporal magic from his future self, revealing a tragic fate twenty years ahead. However, determined to face the self he had long avoided, the "Pig Noble" resolves to struggle and use temporal magic to carve out a different future for himself!

dd36defd-9548-40a3-89e5-8b9877615456.title: Guard Pass
dd36defd-9548-40a3-89e5-8b9877615456.description:
While Im Sejun settles things with his fists, his best friend, Hajin Seo, eats and breathes grappling. Together, they fend off bullies on their school campus, but everything changes after a fight that sets Sejun on a mission to hold those responsible accountable for their crimes. 

What began as a schoolroom brawl quickly turns into a fight for justice and truth as Sejun hits the streets looking for any leads as to what happened on that fateful day.

b7348415-9458-4715-bc0a-8630bf0c2de3.title: S-Rank Butler
b7348415-9458-4715-bc0a-8630bf0c2de3.description:
Butler Kim is the raid leader of the VR game Metariaand in real life the guardian of two cats. One day, a mysterious boss forces him into the unwanted Butler class, where he must serve monsters and do menial chores.

Just as he begins adjusting to this strange new role, an unbelievable truth is revealed:

"A cat… logged into the game?!"

His beloved pet Peechu has entered Metaria.

But Peechu is not just Peechu. The "Master" who reclassified Butler Kim and has been giving him orders is actually Kalinas, the Incarnation of Darkness, now trapped inside the cat’s body.

With the world’s balance at stake, Butler Kim is tasked with carrying out Kalinas’s dark mission. Yet instead of worrying about the will of darkness, is he simply happy to adventure through a fantasy world with Peechu?
